verdict.rationale: LM Studio has no documented sandbox or test mode. Its local-only design still gives an isolated place to test before production: models and the OpenAI-like server run on the local machine (docs-5, docs-9, docs-12), RAG works entirely offline (docs-7), and the headless llmster daemon is positioned for CI (docs-8, docs-31). A community user describes exactly this pattern of testing locally in LM Studio before moving to vllm (comm-7). Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test environment, sandboxed execution for agent and MCP tool calls, documented isolation from production data, and hands-on corroboration of sandboxed testing.
